data_port_example.valid_bytes: 1..16 on final fragment beat;16 on other beats; zero-length work uses explicit program SKIP
data_port_example.whole_sublayer_end: all required fragments and state/output obligations plus terminal JOB_COMPLETE gate
data_port_example.format: compile-time permanent entry/phase/port binding, no generic type/role packet
data_port_example.ordering: one bound fragment per physical port; no interleaving/reordering; no generic routing header
data_port_example.fragment_id_and_length: fixed phase/loop state plus RESULT_SEALED and expected receiver contract; complete binding protocol still to implement

visibility_and_lifetime.PHASE_READY: bounded phase reached; native N/R or output lease may remain and only permitted matching RESUME/CLOSE/CANCEL is admitted
visibility_and_lifetime.RESULT_SEALED: complete bounded chunk generated, numerical errors inspected and required local storage writes ACKed; immutable until release
visibility_and_lifetime.TRANSFER_DONE: all chunk beats accepted into remote endpoint, not proof remote final S/MEM writes ACKed
visibility_and_lifetime.INPUT_STORED: receiver actual designated storage ACKed all required bytes
visibility_and_lifetime.producer_release: mother maps INPUT_STORED to the compiled dependency and sends matching CLOSE; source then releases if all other obligations closed
visibility_and_lifetime.REUSABLE_JOB_COMPLETE: no output lease/native obligations left; retained_phase false; separate from state publication
visibility_and_lifetime.STATE_PUBLISHED: specified full state/history root version made visible after actual required writes and program gates; not R/T/MEM joint atomicity
visibility_and_lifetime.default_transfer: store and seal finite fragment, then forward; receiver space reserved before transmission

require_before_RUN: real input chunk region and holding
real output chunk region and holding
admission_and_deadlock.same_island_producer_consumer: cannot admit consumer RUN while producer task/lease occupies that island; use proven cross-job local buffer lifetime or serial actual MEM staging/ACK/release schedule
admission_and_deadlock.default_conservative_schedule: serialize and materialize through real MEM when resource reuse would form a wait cycle; MEM is not implemented here so dependent full mappings remain gaps
local_drain_progress: S responses captured before another dependent S access
M/N/R responses captured independent of mother WAIT
MEM returns require separate future acceptance/drain contract

fork.policy: ordered copies from immutable source, release after every required consumer INPUT_STORED; no OR of take/ready
fork.mask_does_not_create_routes: one point-to-point output reaches only its wired neighbor; multiple destinations need actual prefabricated multi-landing selection/copies or MEM staging, otherwise mapping gap

join.policy: fixed slots/version/count binding; skipped branch explicitly closed; more inputs need decomposition or prefabricated expansion

admission_and_deadlock.feedback: explicit initial/previous version plus at least one real free buffer credit; verify phase/native/shared-resource wait graph
liveness_assumptions: eventually accepting external peer/MEM or explicit failure

finite_storage_boundaries.prefill_multiplier: actual token count with checked64bit byte arithmetic
finite_storage_boundaries.chunk_size_status: must be bound to actual input/output/workspace reservation and complete-operation math; fragmenting transport does not permit wrong partial Norm/Softmax
finite_storage_boundaries.capture_or_reservation_reuse: only after explicit static lifetime/route proof; otherwise count full cost

R_and_state_versions.root_grain: complete recurrent layer state plus conv-history version, not native tile
two_pass_local_sequence: conv tile compute then read op12 output to private staging
op7 local history commit; wait COPY response
op14 new active history export and actual storage ACK before next OPEN
full-group postprocessing over required128 or4096 logical range
restore old-root state and all required params/factors for each state tile
op7 local state commit; wait COPY response

R_and_state_versions.pending_history_after_failed_state: may survive; explicit local policy required
R_and_state_versions.before_root_publish_failure: old published root retained if not yet observed otherwise; dirty next quarantined and writes drained; replay needs independent correctness proof
R_and_state_versions.after_any_publication_failure: record partial completion and stop; no blind rollback/replay

cancel_reset_and_tags.before_native_valid: cancel unused work and release only proven unused reservations
cancel_reset_and_tags.valid_presented: do not retract unless protocol explicitly allows; handshake then drain
cancel_reset_and_tags.loader_accepted: drain A/B and done; no native abort
cancel_reset_and_tags.R_commit_accepted: protect staging and wait actual COPY response; late revoke cannot undo publication
cancel_reset_and_tags.T_committed: drain/release or separately verified platform discard; revoke only native FILL/SEALED
cancel_reset_and_tags.peer_partial_fragment: cancel agreement and drained prefix counts explicit; cannot report normal fragment complete when beats were dropped
cancel_reset_and_tags.P2_abort: coordinated synchronous reset; previously consumed external prefix cannot be retracted
cancel_reset_and_tags.overflow: stop RUN; drain native/links/retained phases/MEM; explicit coordinated reconstruction before new epoch; epoch exhaustion terminates or full platform reinitialization
cancel_reset_and_tags.native_serial_interfaces: local wrapper binds response to one active record; labels do not add native tags
cancel_reset_and_tags.late_MEM_after_reset: unresolved platform contract, not solved by ignoring unmatched tags
